content: कार {%a.%} (-री|{%f.%}) [कृ-घञ्] (At the end of <ab>comp.</ab>) Making, doing, performing, working, maker, doer, author; ग्रन्थकारः author; कुम्भकारः, सुवर्णकारः <ab>&c.</ab> <ab>&c.</ab> .{@-रः@} .²1 Act, action; as in पुरुषकार. .²2 A term denoting a sound or a word which is not inflected; as अकार <ls>Ms. 2. 76</ls>, <ls n="Ms. 2.">125</ls>; ककार, फूत्कार <ab>&c.</ab> .²3 Effort, exertion; ‘कारौ वधे निश्चये च बले यत्ने रतावपि’ इति विश्वः. <ls>Śi. 19. 27</ls>. .²4 Religious austerity. .²5 A husband, lord; master. .²6 Determination. .²7 Power, strength. .²8 A tax or toll. .²9 A heap of snow. .²10 The Himālaya mountain. .²11 Water produced by hail. .²12 Killing, slaughter.
